links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT versus blinded orthopaedic surgeon in classifying MCID achievement
links.effect: ChatGPT had 97% sensitivity, 33% specificity, 65% accuracy; the surgeon had 90% sensitivity, 63% specificity, 76% accuracy.
links.quote: The surgeon's assessment had 90% sensitivity and 63% specificity.

links.outcome: LLM output accuracy against ground-truth KOOS-JR MCID achievement
links.effect: ChatGPT classified 78 of 80 cases with 97% sensitivity but only 33% specificity; accuracy 65%.
links.quote: ChatGPT classified 78 of 80 cases with 97% sensitivity, but only 33% specificity.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-3.5 in inferring MCID achievement from EHR clinical notes compared to an orthopedic surgeon's review, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
